turns.user: How many 3DCP papers use a viscosity-modifying admixture (VMA)?
turns.text:
I’ll check the literature database schema, then count distinct 3DCP papers associated with the VMA admixture classes.
**403 papers** in the literature database are marked as 3DCP studies and include at least one VMA-class material (cellulose, diutan gum, other polysaccharide, welan gum, or xanthan gum). This is a distinct-paper count.
